question: Will there be Houthi military action against Israel by October 31, 2026?
resolution_criteria: Yes if a Houthi air strike, drone or missile directly impacts Israeli ground territory by October 31, 2026, 11:59 PM IDT. Intercepted munitions do not count. Resolves with Polymarket market will-there-be-houthi-military-action-against-israel-by-october-31-2026.
